summary: This is a routine earnings release on Form 6-K by Arm Holdings plc for its fiscal Q4 and full year ended March 31, 2026. It reports record revenue of $1.49 billion for the quarter and $4.92 billion for the year, along with non-GAAP EPS of $0.60 and $1.77 respectively, and provides business commentary on growth areas. There is no special-situation transaction such as an acquisition, divestiture, tender offer, going-private, or any other special category event. It is an ordinary financial results announcement with no structural change or corporate action requiring special-situation classification.
